name: Discriminator Loss with Gradient Penalty
aliases: Discriminator Loss with Gradient Penalty — GP Loss, Gradient Penalty Loss
definition: A loss function for training the discriminator, including a gradient penalty term to enforce Lipschitz continuity.
summary: Discriminator Loss with Gradient Penalty is a GAN regularization method that stabilizes training by adding an R1 penalty on real data gradients to enforce Lipschitz continuity, avoiding weight clipping.
